architecture: PP2 organization; vLLM TP2 Prefill -> cross-engine NIXL -> SGLang TP4/EP4 full-model Decode
frozen_v8_snapshot: Original V8 snapshot uses seq12; this benchmark records the subsequent live seq32 configuration.

definitions.p_batch_aggregate_tokens_s: input_tokens / (first telemetry timestamp confirming all P requests completed - earliest request started); includes P queuing, excludes D Decode; approximate sampling at 0.5 s plus HTTP collection time; specialized P path only
definitions.p_prefill_service_tokens_s: P prompt counter delta / P request_prefill_time_seconds_sum delta; request service time normalization, not batch wall time
definitions.decode_active_span_aggregate_tokens_s: sum(completion_tokens - 1) / (latest last content timestamp - earliest first content timestamp)
definitions.end_to_end_output_tokens_s: sum(completion_tokens) / (latest response ended - earliest request started)
definitions.per_request_decode_tokens_s_median: median((completion_tokens - 1) / (last content timestamp - first content timestamp))

limitations: 442.02 tok/s comes from short-code C32; 16297.81 tok/s comes from 32768-token C32. They are separate workloads.
16000+ was observed at C16, C24 and C32, one batch each; not a repeated long-duration stability test.
A streaming content packet may contain multiple tokens under speculation; subtracting one token from each response is the original measurement convention.
No matched V7 or H20 workload-and-timing control is supplied by this run.
